purpose: Explicit source-precision-gap Institution tranche: materialize five treaty-body, regional-court, social-rights and African Union institutions while preserving repository-retained propositions and refusing to fabricate missing one-to-one locators.
migrationRule: An Institution counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated Institution dossier. Partial rows preserve the State dossier's explicit proposition and source limitations; missing exact locators remain evidence gaps and never become inferred Claim/EvidenceItem, participation or governance findings.
visualRule: Derived visuals encode State context and label every v24 source surface as partial. R/S/N context and external review, adjudication or accountability activity terminate at the institution identity boundary and never propagate.
